message: Presence in a dataset does not prove a feature was available at the prediction cutoff. Verify each source's publication/ingestion time.

manual_review.question: Confirm the holiday calendar was published/known at the forecast cutoff.
Confirm event schedules were known at the forecast cutoff and do not encode events inferred from the observed target period.
Confirm roadwork information was known at the forecast cutoff.

lag_and_rolling_features.required_rule: Every lag/rolling window must use observations strictly before the forecast timestamp; rolling windows must be shifted before aggregation. Confirm this in the Day 8 feature-generation code.
